title: PokéBench Score
aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean over the same 30 fixtures per system
normalization: Fixed natural 0–100 endpoints; no scaling against the observed models
overlap: Wins already have 100% HP depletion. The equivalent per-battle rule explicitly accounts for this overlap.
interpretation: Win credit plus partial loss credit; not a probability or a percentage of battles won
weight_basis: Transparent benchmark design choice, not estimated from the scores or established as statistically optimal
future_policy: Keep the v1 formula fixed for future cohorts; changes require a new metric version
